TRANSACTION - FUNCTIONAL DESCRIPTION: Modifies a pricing rule that is being used for payments on EVA platform
EXECUTION FLOWS - DETAILED DESCRIPTION: The transaction obtains the pricing rule identifier and pricing rule request from the input parameters. It reads the user code from the request header and invokes ABKOR001.executePutPricingRules(pricingRuleId, pricingRuleRequest, auditUserId). The returned pricing rule is assigned to pricingRuleResponse. If the transaction advice list is not empty after the library invocation, the transaction sets the severity to EWR.

Accessed Libraries.Description: Updates an existing pricing rule using its identifier, the requested pricing rule data and the audit user identifier, returning the modified pricing rule.

Error Management.Description of the error situation: Pricing Rule with id: {id} not found
The pricing rule with id {id} is inactive and cannot be modified
Only rules in state PAA, REJ, SYE or SYC can be modified.
Start date can not be before than current date
Pricing Rule conflicts with an existing VARIABLE rule. Existing Rule ID: {id}
Pricing Rule conflicts with an existing VARIABLE rule with different fee. Existing Rule ID: {id}
Pricing Rule conflicts with an existing VARIABLE rule due to payment method overlap. Existing Rule ID: {id}
Detail id: {id} does not exist for entity type: {entityType}
Database operation failed while updating the pricing rule or its details.

Input Parameters.Description: Identifier of the pricing rule to be modified.
Pricing rule data containing the values to update, including its name, fee, effective dates, recurrence times, details, precedence type, progressive type and comments.

Output Parameters.Description: Modified pricing rule returned by the ABKOR001 library, including its identifier, updated values, status and enriched detail values.
